name: v-menu
description: V-Menu: QR-code restaurant ordering as three microservices and a Next.js frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,restaurant,menu,order,web -c gray,magenta,yellow,cyan,green "npm:dev:db" "npm --prefix services/restaurant-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/menu-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/order-service run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n restaurant,menu,order -c magenta,yellow,cyan "npm --prefix services/restaurant-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/menu-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/order-service run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/restaurant-service test && npm --prefix services/menu-service test && npm --prefix services/order-service test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix services/restaurant-service run typecheck && npm --prefix services/menu-service run typecheck && npm --prefix services/order-service run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
